description: List Reservation (RI) and Savings Plan utilization/coverage snapshots for this account — sourced from AWS Cost Explorer's own GetReservationUtilization/GetSavingsPlansUtilization APIs, one snapshot per commitment type per month. Shows how much of a purchased commitment is actually being used and its net savings vs on-demand. Mirrors GET /api/accounts/:accountId/commitment-utilization.
name: list_commitment_utilization
